theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_dlb_restricted_firstVariation_control
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Euclidean N)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (W : Varifold N n Ω) (c β : ℝ≥0∞), c ≠ ∞ → β ≠ ∞ → W.measure = c • μ.restrict (Ω ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → (∀ X : Euclidean N → Euclidean N, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ Ω → (∀ y, ‖X y‖ ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ z, Varifold.tangentialDivergence X z.1 z.2 ∂μ| ≤ β) → W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation ∧ ∀ O : Set (Euclidean N), IsRelCompactOpenIn O Ω → variationMeasure W O ≤ c * β
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
